reviews.comment:
El lugar para parar en la ruta. Tiene todos los servicios que un viajero puede requerir. Con mi familia llevamos a nuestra mascota y pudimos bajar al parque, jugar, cargar nafta y comer algo.  Ideal para parar con chicos, ya que hay juegos de plaza y espacio para patear una pelota. Hay mucha gente en fechas claves, pero el servicio es rápido.

(Translated by Google)
The perfect place to stop along the route. It has all the services a traveler could need. My family and I brought our pet and were able to go down to the park, play, fill up with gas, and grab a bite to eat. Ideal for stopping with kids, as there's a playground and space to kick a ball around. It gets busy on peak dates, but the service is fast.
